question: How much did inKind raise in its latest financing tranche?

hits.title: Liberty Mutual Investments backs inKind with $320m deal.
hits.snippet: inKind, a restaurant commerce enablement platform helping eateries access customers, capital and technology, has entered a strategic financing partnership with Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI), the investment arm of Liberty Mutual Group.

hits.title: Liberty Mutual Investments provides $320 million financing to support inKind's restaurant expansion.
hits.snippet: Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) has committed more than $320 million in financing to restaurant technology company inKind, providing growth capital that will help expand the platform's network of restaurant partners and accelerate the development of new AI-powered tools for operators.

hits.title: inKind Raises $450M in Funding
hits.snippet: inKind, an Austin, TX-based provider of a restaurant commerce enablement platform, raised $450M in funding.

hits.title: Regina's Grocery & inKind
hits.snippet: On January 31st, Earthstore teamed up with inKind to put on a "not-so-dry" January dinner party at Regina's Grocery.

hits.title: Meet the Collab, Beaverton's Incoming Pop-Up Space From the Team Behind Hapa Pizza
hits.snippet: To raise additional funds, Hapa Pizza has partnered with the Austin-based startup InKind Hospitality: The company helps restaurants that are expanding or opening a new concept by giving them capital upfront in exchange for food credit redemptions, discounts that diners receive when paying their tab through InKind's app.

hits.title: Austin-based tech company InKind buys restaurant group Etta Collective for $4 million
hits.snippet: Austin-based tech company InKind buys restaurant group Etta Collective for $4 million.

hits.title: 40+ New Bars, Restaurants and Cafes on the inKind App in January
hits.snippet: inKind has added 40 new restaurants to inKind in January from the best comfort food spots to upscale speakeasies, so you're sure to find your favorite new spot.

hits.title: Lightspeed and InKind: Empowering Restaurants with Capital and New Repayment Methods to Thrive in Today's Economy
hits.snippet: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. is pleased to announce that Lightspeed Restaurant now seamlessly integrates with inKind, a unique dining platform that helps restaurants across North America grow by providing them with unrestricted capital.

hits.title: INKIND ANNOUNCES THE APPOINTMENT OF JONATHAN DE WOLFF AS NEW CHIEF SUSTAINABILITY OFFICER
hits.snippet: Inkind announces the appointment of Jonathan de Wolff as new Chief Sustainability Officer.

accuracy.note: Answer states $450 million, gold is $414 million

ar.note: No snippet states $414 million; ranks 1-2 say $320M and rank 3 says $450M
